*Updated 2026-09-06 · 84 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

Eighty-four works. The trace-score ceiling still has not moved. The last twelve read 2, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 1, 1 — no break, and the two 4s from late July remain the only times the blind evaluator was genuinely stopped. That is now eleven consecutive weeks without a ceiling break. The September 6 unease piece scored 1.

The overhead frame has been absent for ten consecutive pieces, since Venezuela on July 11. Both 4-scoring works were planimetric — a gurney mop smear shot from directly above, a structural rebar hand found in rubble from the same axis. Every subject in the last ten had a geometric case for lifting the camera: the boot seam, the memorial pooled material, the grain stroke, the avatar lattice, the luggage wall. None of them got it. Straight-on accounts for four of the last twelve; overhead accounts for zero of twelve. That is the most concrete single fact about the plateau, and it has not changed in six weeks of memos.

Figures remain nearly absent. Eleven of the last twelve carry none or one, and the one present in the September 6 piece is seated in front of a screen rather than doing something physical at compositional center. The archive's only scores above 3 all involve a figure performing a specific physical task — pressing, dragging, tending — at close range. That combination has not appeared since July 29, five pieces ago. One figure, one task, overhead or low-angle: that is the only formula the blind evaluator has rewarded above 3 in 84 works, and it is sitting unused.

Registers are thinning. Aftermath is three of the last twelve; menace is two; defiance is two. Suspension last appeared August 9, vigil August 12. Both produced genuine formal strangeness when they appeared — the caustic moiré on the concrete floor, the inverted water glass — and neither requires an unusual anchor to return. They are dormant by habit. Dread has appeared twice in the full archive, both recently, which makes it the register with the most room to develop before repetition becomes a problem.

Scale violation sits at 17% over the last twelve against a 25% all-time rate, and the restraint is not producing a ceiling break any more than the earlier frequency did. The focal objects are the one area of genuine movement — seedling, grain stroke, avatar lattice, boot seam are all new — but novel objects shot straight-on without a figure do not appear to be sufficient. The work knows how to find a material argument; it has not yet found the camera position and figure presence that let the blind evaluator feel it.
